name: READ_SECTORS / TRANSFER_DATA
evidence: Builds MSF/BCD fields, sends 0x40 status, sends 0xC0 read packet, enters interrupt/counter transfer loop.
replacement_relevance: Critical. This is the path needed for A:\CONTROL.TAT and title file reads.

name: GET_POSITION_OR_STATUS_WITH_MSF
evidence: Consumes/stores MSF-like fields, uses status checks, branches on the same media/ready flags as read path.
replacement_relevance: Implement as status/position response tolerant of current read pointer.

name: GET_SINGLE_POSITION_OR_COMPACT_STATUS
evidence: Smaller sibling of 82h. Uses request-supplied position/state fields and status polling.
replacement_relevance: Likely safe to return stable ready/current-position data in prototype.

name: RANGE_COMMAND / PLAY_OR_RANGE_TRANSFER
evidence: Builds start/end MSF fields and can issue a 0xC0 packet with special/zero count. Uses 0x50 mode changes.
replacement_relevance: Probably not required for first CONTROL.TAT read, but useful for full title/audio compatibility.

name: MEDIA_STATUS_OR_CURRENT_LOCATION
evidence: Sends 0x40 status and 0x70 hold/pause, checks media/attention bits, stores/returns MSF-ish fields.
replacement_relevance: Return ready/no-change status and current MSF for prototype.

name: MEDIA_READY_CHANGE_GATE
evidence: Checks cached media flags, sends 0x40 status, evaluates media/ready/error bits.
replacement_relevance: Important. Replacement should consistently report disc present, ready, no media change once mounted.
